rules.name: ouat178-k27-inputs
rules.sql: SELECT security_id, derivative_type, product_code, underlying1_id, underlying2_id, vol1_id, vol2_id, strike, strike1, strike2, maturity_date, settlement_type, quanto_type, currency, contract_month, status FROM opera.security_info_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND security_id IN ('CM WP H27.H27 CM WP H27.H27 P 106 CS', 'CM WP K27.K27 CM WP K27.K27 P 125 CS')
SELECT * FROM dbsystemuat.security_info_table_cfs WHERE security_id IN ('CM WP H27.H27 CM WP H27.H27 P 106 CS', 'CM WP K27.K27 CM WP K27.K27 P 125 CS')
SELECT bbg_underlying_id, settlement_date, price, vol FROM opera.var_price_vol_table WHERE settlement_date = :sd AND bbg_underlying_id IN ('QWH7', 'SBH7', 'QWK7', 'SBK7') ORDER BY bbg_underlying_id
SELECT * FROM dbsystemuat.var_price_vol_table WHERE settlement_date = :sd AND bbg_underlying_id IN ('QWH7', 'SBH7', 'QWK7', 'SBK7') ORDER BY bbg_underlying_id

SELECT vol_id, bbg_opt_ticker, expiry_date, underlying_id FROM opera.vol_id_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND vol_id IN ('CM QW H27.H27', 'CM SB H27.H27', 'CM QW K27.K27', 'CM SB K27.K27') ORDER BY vol_id
SELECT * FROM dbsystemuat.vol_id_table WHERE vol_id IN ('CM QW H27.H27', 'CM SB H27.H27', 'CM QW K27.K27', 'CM SB K27.K27') ORDER BY vol_id
